title: Colorado Revised Statutes, Title 38, Article 12 - Tenants and Landlords
verified_how: Expanded the official CRS Annotated table of contents: 'Title 38. Property - Real and Personal (ss 38-1-101 - 38-53-110)' > 'Tenants and Landlords (Art. 12)' > 'Article 12. Tenants and Landlords (Pts. 1 - 15)', listed live between 'Joint Rights and Obligations (Art. 11)' and 'Unclaimed Property (Art. 13)'.
notes: Article 12 covers security deposits, the warranty of habitability, mobile home park tenancies and the recent rental-practice reforms. Eviction procedure (forcible entry and detainer) is in Title 13, art. 40. General consumer protection is the Colorado Consumer Protection Act, Title 6, art. 1, which was not examined; only one statute per topic is listed.
